name: agentlenspro-review-mod
description: The harness runs the adversarial REVIEW (and, for a proposal, the MEASUREMENT) of every main turn via $.model.fork and of every typed subagent turn via $.model.complete, blocks on findings, and injects every report into the parent model's next prompt; interrupted turns are reviewed too. Janitor turns, internal agents and agent-message turns that changed nothing are exempt. The model spawns nothing. Usage is shown to the user only; the coloured copy of each report is printed by a Stop/SubagentStop command hook (needs python3). Needs the agentlenspro CLI with work/proposal in review-gate --json-verdict.

show_reviewed_turn.title: Show the turn under review in the usage box
show_reviewed_turn.description: Add the token usage and cost of the turn being reviewed (the previous turn) above the review turn in the usage box.
